SMB-SYNC-PREFERENCES(8) System Manager's Manual SMB-SYNC-PREFERENCES(8)

NAME

smb-sync-preferences — synchronize SMB server preferences

SYNOPSIS

/usr/libexec/smb-sync-preferences

DESCRIPTION

Used by launchd only. Synchronizes preferences when SMB server preferences are modified.

other(8),
